lines.text: Wait! Why Fingers Turn Pruney in Water (Brain Grip Trick!)!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why fingers wrinkle in water!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Your nervous system narrows tiny blood vessels under wet skin to.
build rain-tire wrinkles that help your fingers grip slippery toys underwater.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Water Grip Skin!
